title: Multi-state analyses with OmopMultistate
text: start three states: treated, untreated, death. row marks entry state. cohort definition identifies state subject_id identifies person. default, cohort_start_date entry date; cohort_end_date alone create exit transition. treatment episodes, construct explicit discontinuation cohort want treatment end create entry untreated state. eight example histories include direct deaths, discontinuations, people start untreated, people censored without event. Days relative 1 January 2020. support stratified examples later, repeat histories four groups, small differences event dates. helper creates 32 people, eight sex age-group combination. Observation ends day 120 everyone. also add administrative censor date day 75 later example. settings(cdm$states) describes input cohorts, including names identifiers. Later, settings(result) describe analysis.
code: indexDate <- as.Date("2020-01-01") paths <- tribble(   ~person, ~cohort_definition_id, ~day,   1L, 1L,   0L,   1L, 2L,  20L,   1L, 3L,  80L,   2L, 1L,   0L,   2L, 3L,  50L,   3L, 1L,   0L,   3L, 2L,  35L,   4L, 1L,   0L,   4L, 2L,  15L,   4L, 3L,  95L,   5L, 2L,   0L,   5L, 3L, 105L,   6L, 2L,   0L,   6L, 3L,  60L,   7L, 1L,   0L,   8L, 1L,   0L,   8L, 2L,  45L,   8L, 3L, 110L ) expandPaths <- function(x) {   tidyr::crossing(block = 1:4, x) |>     mutate(       subject_id = as.integer((block - 1L) * 8L + person),       cohort_start_date = indexDate +         if_else(day == 0L, 0L, day + 2L * (block - 1L)),       cohort_end_date = cohort_start_date,       sex = if_else(block <= 2L, "Female", "Male"),       age_group = if_else(block %% 2L == 1L, "younger", "older"),       administrative_censor_date = indexDate + 75L     ) |>     select(       cohort_definition_id, subject_id, cohort_start_date, cohort_end_date,       sex, age_group, administrative_censor_date     ) }  cohort <- expandPaths(paths) observationPeriod <- tibble(   observation_period_id = 1:32,   person_id = 1:32,   observation_period_start_date = indexDate - 30L,   observation_period_end_date = indexDate + 120L,   period_type_concept_id = 0L )  cdm <- mockCdmFromTables(tables = list(   states = cohort,   observation_period = observationPeriod )) cdm$states <- renameCohort(cdm$states, c("treated", "untreated", "death"))  settings(cdm$states) |>   knitr::kable()

title: Multi-State Analyses Using the OMOP Common Data Model
text: following example models acetaminophen treatment, discontinuation, restarting treatment, death absorbing state. uses synthetic synpuf-1k dataset, omock downloads first use, temporary DuckDB database. example requires omock, CohortConstructor, CodelistGenerator, CDMConnector, duckdb; plotting also requires visOmopResults, ggplot2, scales. function help pages provide smaller examples using bundled GiBleed dataset model first discontinuation, untreated absorbing. examples run locally without dataset download database connection. use CohortConstructor create three cohorts: acetaminophen treatment, discontinuation (untreated), death (death_cohort). Cohort names must match state names transition matrix. Cohort start dates mark state entries; reaching cohort end date alone create state change, construct discontinuation explicitly. Requiring day treatment end within observation prevents loss follow-counted discontinuation. permitted transitions : acetaminophen untreated acetaminophen death_cohort untreated acetaminophen untreated death_cohort Rows describe state left columns describe destination. NA entry forbids transition; row containing NA makes state absorbing. records can occur date. resolve ties logical order, placing death last absorbing state. default, stateStep = 0.01 separates successive priority ranks hundredths day. Without hierarchy, simultaneous competing states cause error. person’s time zero first entry state outgoing transition. , first recorded treatment discontinuation. Follow-ends observation end default. supplied censorDate column replaces default, missing dates falling back observation end; custom dates automatically capped observation end. Use consistent endpoint across person’s state records administrative censor date. can prepare data long format used mstate fit models: Tstart Tstop days since time zero. status = 1 identifies observed transition; possible transitions interval status = 0. estimate state occupation probabilities, use summariseMultistateProbabilities(). followUpDays argument limits time points returned fitting; use censorDate change input follow-endpoint. run interactively, functions can print informational (ℹ) messages records excluded. example, person death record never enters eligible initial state contribute analysis. messages describe input data; R warnings. tidy(), variable_name identifies destination state (example, prob_untreated), variable_level contains elapsed days character values, probability proportion zero one. initial_state gives state probabilities conditioned. initial_state = "overall" weights state-specific estimates observed starting-state distribution. settings(result) records analysis settings, including transition structure. Probabilities returned model time points rather every day. row exactly followUpDays guaranteed. can visualise now results. States displayed order appear transition matrix:
code: library(OmopMultistate) library(omock) library(CohortConstructor) library(CodelistGenerator) library(dplyr)  cdm <- mockCdmFromDataset(datasetName = "synpuf-1k", source = "duckdb")  cdm codes <- getDrugIngredientCodes(cdm = cdm, name = "acetaminophen", nameStyle = "{concept_name}")  # acetaminophen cohort cdm$acetaminophen <- conceptCohort(cdm = cdm, conceptSet = codes, name = "acetaminophen") #> ℹ Subsetting table drug_exposure using 6620 concepts with domain: drug. #> ℹ Combining tables. #> ℹ Creating cohort attributes. #> ℹ Applying cohort requirements. #> ℹ Merging overlapping records. #> ✔ Cohort acetaminophen created.  # death cohort cdm$death_cohort <- deathCohort(cdm = cdm, name = "death_cohort") #> ℹ Applying cohort requirements. #> ✔ Cohort death_cohort created.  # untreated cohort cdm$untreated <- cdm$acetaminophen |>   padCohortEnd(days = 1L, requireFullContribution = TRUE, name = "untreated") |>   padCohortDate(days = 0L, indexDate = "cohort_end_date", cohortDate = "cohort_start_date") |>   renameCohort("untreated")  # bind them together cdm <- bind(cdm$acetaminophen, cdm$death_cohort, cdm$untreated, name = "my_study")  # the created cohort settings(cdm$my_study) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   cohort_definition_id cohort_name   cdm_version vocabulary_version #>                  <int> <chr>         <chr>       <chr> #> 1                    1 acetaminophen 5.4         v5.0 29-APR-16 #> 2                    2 death_cohort  <NA>        <NA> #> 3                    3 untreated     5.4         v5.0 29-APR-16 #> # ℹ 2 more variables: subset_cohort_table <chr>, subset_cohort_id <chr> trans <- transMat(   x = list(c(2, 3), c(1, 3), c()),   names = c("acetaminophen", "untreated", "death_cohort") )  trans #>                to #> from            acetaminophen untreated death_cohort #>   acetaminophen            NA         1            2 #>   untreated                 3        NA            4 #>   death_cohort             NA        NA           NA stateHierarchy <- c("acetaminophen", "untreated", "death_cohort") msData <- prepareMultistateData(   cohort = cdm$my_study,   trans = trans,   stateHierarchy = stateHierarchy )  msData |>   arrange(subject_id, Tstart) |>   head(10) #> An object of class 'msdata' #> #> Data: #>    subject_id from to trans Tstart Tstop status     from_name       to_name #> 1           1    1  2     1      0    30      1 acetaminophen     untreated #> 2           1    1  3     2      0    30      0 acetaminophen  death_cohort #> 3           1    2  1     3     30   373      1     untreated acetaminophen #> 4           1    2  3     4     30   373      0     untreated  death_cohort #> 5           1    1  2     1    373   403      1 acetaminophen     untreated #> 6           1    1  3     2    373   403      0 acetaminophen  death_cohort #> 7           1    2  1     3    403   532      1     untreated acetaminophen #> 8           1    2  3     4    403   532      0     untreated  death_cohort #> 9           1    1  2     1    532   552      1 acetaminophen     untreated #> 10          1    1  3     2    532   552      0 acetaminophen  death_cohort result <- summariseMultistateProbabilities(   cohort = cdm$my_study,   trans = trans,   stateHierarchy = stateHierarchy ) tidy(result) |>   head() #> # code: library(CohortConstructor) library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’ #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’: #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’: #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union library(omock) library(OmopMultistate)  cdm <- mockCdmFromDataset(datasetName = "GiBleed") #> ℹ Loading bundled GiBleed tables from package data. #> ℹ Adding drug_strength table. #> ℹ Creating local <cdm_reference> object.  # An illustrative concept set: aspirin 81 mg oral tablets. # Keep the first treatment episode for each person. cdm$treated <- conceptCohort(   cdm = cdm,   conceptSet = list(treated = 19059056L),   name = "treated" ) |>   requireIsFirstEntry() #> ℹ Subsetting table drug_exposure using 1 concept with domain: drug. #> ℹ Combining tables. #> ℹ Creating cohort attributes. #> ℹ Applying cohort requirements. #> ℹ Merging overlapping records. #> ✔ Cohort treated created.  # Enter the untreated state the day after treatment ends. Require that day # to be within observation, so loss to follow-up is not a discontinuation. cdm$untreated <- cdm$treated |>   padCohortEnd(days = 1L, requireFullContribution = TRUE, name = "untreated") |>   padCohortDate(     days = 0L, indexDate = "cohort_end_date", cohortDate = "cohort_start_date"   ) |>   renameCohort("untreated") cdm <- bind(cdm$treated, cdm$untreated, name = "states")  # Model first discontinuation: untreated is an absorbing state. # Matrix state names must match the cohort names. trans <- transMat(   x = list(2, integer()),   names = c("treated", "untreated") )  cdm$states <- PatientProfiles::addSex(cdm$states) result <- summariseMultistateProbabilities(   cohort = cdm$states,   trans = trans,   strata = list("sex"),   followUpDays = 365,   stateHierarchy = c("treated", "untreated") ) #> `cohort_table_name` eliminated from settings as all elements are NA.  # Show the overall probabilities for people starting treatment. result |>   filterGroup(initial_state == "treated") |>   filterStrata(sex == "overall") |>   plotMultistateProbabilities()   # Compare the sex strata in separate panels, with time displayed in years. result |>   filterGroup(initial_state == "treated") |>   filterStrata(sex != "overall") |>   plotMultistateProbabilities(timeScale = "years")   cdmDisconnect(cdm)

code: library(CohortConstructor) library(dplyr) library(omock) library(OmopMultistate)  cdm <- mockCdmFromDataset(datasetName = "GiBleed") #> ℹ Loading bundled GiBleed tables from package data. #> ℹ Adding drug_strength table. #> ℹ Creating local <cdm_reference> object.  # An illustrative concept set: aspirin 81 mg oral tablets. # Keep the first treatment episode for each person. cdm$treated <- conceptCohort(   cdm = cdm,   conceptSet = list(treated = 19059056L),   name = "treated" ) |>   requireIsFirstEntry() #> ℹ Subsetting table drug_exposure using 1 concept with domain: drug. #> ℹ Combining tables. #> ℹ Creating cohort attributes. #> ℹ Applying cohort requirements. #> ℹ Merging overlapping records. #> ✔ Cohort treated created.  # Enter the untreated state the day after treatment ends. Require that day # to be within observation, so loss to follow-up is not a discontinuation. cdm$untreated <- cdm$treated |>   padCohortEnd(days = 1L, requireFullContribution = TRUE, name = "untreated") |>   padCohortDate(     days = 0L,     indexDate = "cohort_end_date",     cohortDate = "cohort_start_date"   ) |>   renameCohort("untreated") cdm <- bind(cdm$treated, cdm$untreated, name = "states")  # Model first discontinuation: untreated is an absorbing state. # Matrix state names must match the cohort names. trans <- transMat(   x = list(2, integer()),   names = c("treated", "untreated") )  # By default, follow-up ends at the end of each person's observation period. # Resolve any same-day states by placing treatment before discontinuation. msData <- prepareMultistateData(   cohort = cdm$states,   trans = trans,   stateHierarchy = c("treated", "untreated") )  # One row per possible transition and time interval; status = 1 is an event. msData |>   arrange(subject_id, Tstart) |>   head() #> An object of class 'msdata' #>  #> Data: #>   subject_id from to trans Tstart Tstop status from_name   to_name #> 1          1    1  2     1      0    29      1   treated untreated #> 2          2    1  2     1      0    15      1   treated untreated #> 3          3    1  2     1      0    22      1   treated untreated #> 4          5    1  2     1      0    68      1   treated untreated #> 5          6    1  2     1      0    15      1   treated untreated #> 6          7    1  2     1      0    15      1   treated untreated  cdmDisconnect(cdm)
